questions: If multiple people have the same maximum score, are their ranks determined in any particular order (e.g., by original label), or does the order not matter as long as they all get the same rank r?
Should the output be printed in the order of person labels (1 to N), or in the order ranks were determined (descending score order)?
Is r initialized to 1, or to some other value (e.g., 0 or N)?
If all scores are distinct, does the procedure still work correctly (i.e., ranks are 1 for highest, 2 for second, etc.)?
Are scores guaranteed to be integers, and if so, can they be negative or zero?
Should the output include a newline after the last line, or is that flexible?
If N=0 (though constraint says N≥1), how should the function behave?
Is the input guaranteed to be on two lines exactly, with the second line containing exactly N integers separated by spaces?
